text:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 - continuous-batch latency cliff observed on prod-us-west-2. Queue depth > 1200, 95p token-latency spike, KV cache evictions ramping. Auto-escalating to #eng-oncall.

sam: seeing huge eviction churn in kvcache metrics, prefetch rate just doubled in last 3m.

lia: confirmed, microbatch sizes also oscillating between 8->256 which is causing jitter. Related to the new prefetch heuristic rollout.

pranav: paging oncall owner @sam — are we in a canary or full rollout?

sam: full rollout for prefetch v2 went at 01:08 UTC. I rolled the policy quickly but maybe the heuristics are over-eager at high concurrency.

kevin: customer-facing: a small subset of heavy-traffic tenants seeing 5xx and timeouts. Notified support to hold PSAT.

maria: putting brief mitigation plan: 1) throttle prefetch, 2) clamp microbatch max, 3) enable fallback model-variant without aggressive caching.

sam: agreed. applying throttling now — patching prefetch.max_lookback -> 4 (was 32).

lia: +1. also reducing microbatch cap to 64 tokens to avoid giant merges.

sam: running command:
```bash
redwoodctl set-config --service runtime --key prefetch.max_lookback --value 4 --env prod-us-west-2
redwoodctl set-config --service batching --key max_microbatch_tokens --value 64 --env prod-us-west-2
```

incident-bot: Deploy triggered: config-patch/prevent-prefetch-blast -> rolling to 30% -> 100% (ETA ~2m).

pranav: is there a fast hotpatch to disable prefetch entirely if churn continues?

sam: yes — we have `prefetch.enabled=false` flag. Keeping as last resort because it increases cost.

kevin: support: initial customer impact list - 7 tenants hit transient errors, SLA degradations for 2 high-volume customers. I'm drafting a short status note.

maria: telemetry shows queue depth dropping after the throttle patch. 95p latency down from 2.4s -> 850ms in last 90s. KV evictions also falling.

lia: microbatch jitter reduced after clamp. We still see some tail traces where microbatches coalesce; need to tune jitter_ms.

sam: bumping jitter to 8ms to spread merges:
```yaml
batching:
  max_microbatch_tokens: 64
  jitter_ms: 8
```

incident-bot: Hotfix rollout complete at 5432110000. System status: degraded -> recovering.

pranav: good recovery. next steps: revert prefetch v2 rollout in canary and hold until we have more telemetry and synthetic evals.

maria: creating follower task: postmortem owner @lia, include hypothesis: prefetch heuristic mis-estimated prefix hit rates at high concurrency causing cross-tenant cache pressure + batch coalescing.

kevin: tagging customers in support ticket, offering warm handshake. Operations: schedule a 1hr blameless postmortem sync + action items.

lia: noting action items: (a) add an emergency kill-switch for prefetch at runtime, (b) add rollout guard that checks kvcache eviction rate and halts, (c) extend microbatch jitter experiment to more clusters.

sam: I've posted the quick metrics graph in #eng-sre with links to traces and the partial rollback diff.

pranav: thumbs up. I'll follow up with the canary revert request and coordinate with CD to hold further prefetch changes.

kevin: support note sent to impacted customers, setting expectation: short blip resolved with config rollback.

maria: closing pager but leaving thread open for postmortem. Thanks everyone. :heart:

sam: dropping follow-up playbook items in the runbook: prefetch rollout checklist + kvcache guard thresholds.

lia: opening postmortem doc and will assign next steps.

incident-bot: Pager closed (duration ~18m).
